abstract: Published online: 23 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43246-026-01377-6 Aluminum foil anodes are promising for rechargeable <mark>lithium</mark> batteries, but difficult delithiation causes cracking, passivation, and capacity loss. Here, the authors show that Mn alloying enables reversible delithiation in aluminum foil anodes, improving cycle life and efficiency.
